parts.label: (a)
parts.text:
In continuous variation, a population shows a range of phenotypes between two extremes with no distinct groups. Height and mass are examples of phenotypic traits that show continuous variation.

Describe the genetic basis for continuous variation.

parts.label: (b)
parts.text:
Environmental factors can contribute to continuous variation.

Suggest **two** environmental factors that may affect the body mass of an animal.

parts.label: (c)
parts.text:
Humans have used selective breeding (artificial selection) for thousands of years to improve the quality of livestock.

Outline the principles of selective breeding in livestock.
